config:
# Generated by the Hypnos advisor (API-12) for unified memory with 32 GiB of RAM; needs: chat, vision, voice.
# Download the files first: ./run.sh models <id>:<quant> for each model below.
config_version = 1

[server]
models_dir = "models"

[hardware]
accelerator = "apple_metal_uma"
vram_budget_bytes = 0
vram_safety_margin_bytes = 2147483648
lock_host_memory = false
pinned_ram_budget_bytes = 7158278828

# Gemma 4 12B (Q4_0), Google, license apache-2.0. From models.catalog.toml.
[[models]]
id = "gemma4:12b-q4"
modality = "text_generation"
additional_modalities = ["vision", "speech_to_text"]
engine = "ggml_llama"
weights_path = "gemma-4-12B-it-Q4_0.gguf"
aux_weights_path = "mmproj-gemma-4-12B-it-BF16.gguf"
total_weight_bytes = 7394788864
initial_tier = "tier1_gpu_vram"
keep_warm_in_ram = false
min_gpu_layer_ratio = 0.25
priority = "high"
slots = 3

[models.arch]
activation_workspace_bytes = 2818572288
default_context_len = 16384
kv_dtype = "q8_0"
non_layer_overhead_bytes = 1610612736

# LFM3-Omni 2B (Q4_K_M), Liquid AI, license lfm1.0. From models.catalog.toml.
[[models]]
id = "lfm3-omni:2b"
modality = "text_generation"
additional_modalities = ["vision", "speech_to_text", "text_to_speech"]
engine = "ggml_llama"
weights_path = "LFM3-Omni-2B-Q4_K_M.gguf"
aux_weights_path = "mmproj-LFM3-Omni-2B-Q8_0.gguf"
total_weight_bytes = 1606472480
initial_tier = "tier1_gpu_vram"
keep_warm_in_ram = true
min_gpu_layer_ratio = 1.0
priority = "high"

[models.arch]
activation_workspace_bytes = 2147483648
default_context_len = 16384
kv_dtype = "q8_0"
non_layer_overhead_bytes = 838860800
